english.title: Fail to notify Secretary of State regarding possession / control of an animal suspected of being infected with a TSE
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having in your possession or under your control,

(A)_[an animal]_
(B)_[animals]_

suspected of being infected with a TSE, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), failed to notify the Secretary of State and detain the

(C)_[animal]_
(D)_[animals]_

on the holding until

(E)_[it]_
(F)_[they]_

had been examined by a veterinary inspector
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(1) and 18(1)(a) of the Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (England) Regulations 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
